app.title: End-to-end infrastructure for training and inferencing open weight models
app.author: Bluestein
app.description: A containerized platform that orchestrates training and inference of open‑weight models, integrating dataset handling, hyper‑parameter tuning, and model deployment.
proposed_tests: run a minimal training job on a toy dataset and measure wall‑time
deploy a pre‑trained model via the API and measure inference latency
use the SDK to fetch job status programmatically
